decisions.quote: Results: Replicating results from a prior study, reassurance seeking predicted underperformance on the ACT.
decisions.reason: Prior adjudication and state files are absent (never previously adjudicated). The supplied primary text is an abstract-only record (with no in-text citation or reference list) that explicitly reports replicating a prior empirical study's finding that test-related reassurance seeking predicts underperformance on the ACT. Because the abstract does not name the prior study's authors, year, title, or DOI, the blind coder left the target identity fields blank. Shipped row 2076 (Knoll, Valentiner, & Holzman, 2016, 'Development and Initial Test of the Safety Behaviors in Test Anxiety Questionnaire: Superstitious Behavior, Reassurance Seeking, Test Anxiety, and Test Performance', Assessment, doi:10.1177/1073191116686685) shares lead investigator David P. Valentiner and investigates reassurance seeking, test anxiety, and test performance, making it a plausible match for the unnamed prior study. However, neither the supplied abstract nor the Crossref metadata for 10.1177/1073191116686685 establishes whether Knoll et al. (2016) reported the specific ACT underperformance finding or whether the abstract refers to a different prior publication. The precise unresolved question is whether the unnamed prior study replicated in 10.1080/10615806.2020.1763140 is shipped row 2076 (Knoll, Valentiner, & Holzman, 2016) or another unrepresented work.
